node.title: Annex 9 — Claims and Evidence Appendix
node.reading: This page is a technical verification annex to the public-facing foundation article . It is not the canonical source or a standalone article. For the authoritative technical material, use the canonical Ecosystem Positioning README and the versioned sources it indexes. This annex makes the relationship between claims, evidence and stated limitations inspectable and traceable. Publication on Tegrity.AI does not imply peer review, independent validation, production readiness, adoption as a standard or endorsement by the ITU, FG-TIDA or any cited organisation.
node.readingSummary: This page is a technical verification annex to the public-facing foundation article .

relations: Oracle definitions, resource estimates and demonstrated results should carry separate evidence labels rather than sharing a single quantum-performance claim.
Un objeto de investigación bien definido no equivale a un experimento cuántico ejecutado.
Several articles may interpret the same deployment evidence; their shared provenance should remain visible rather than being counted as independent deployments.
Varias interpretaciones del mismo material pueden aportar análisis, pero no nuevos despliegues independientes.
Each portfolio capability should link to evidence with its maturity stated explicitly: historical deployment, reconstruction, design, test or hypothesis.
La presencia de un paper en el corpus no acredita madurez comercial, validación independiente ni certificación.
The component verification record is useful technical evidence when its same-author scope and unresolved independent-validation obligations remain attached.
No se rerunearon sus controles en esta revisión ni se transforma PASS documental en aceptación científica.
An audited-Q claim becomes testable when audit observations, fallibility, scope and cost are explicit, rather than supplied as a favorable Boolean flag.
La nueva observación sigue siendo sintética; no acredita la calidad de auditores reales ni valida el exterior abierto.
